meta.name: Dots and boxes
meta.tagline: Sew a quilt together, one stitch at a time.

rules.one: Take turns sewing one seam between two neighbouring pins.
rules.two: Close the fourth side of a patch and it's yours, in your print, and you sew again.
rules.three: When the quilt is whole, whoever holds the most patches wins.
rules.seats: 2 to 4 players; a new game in the same room starts with the next player.

play.lookUp: Look at the big screen. It's {{name}}'s turn.
play.seamAcross: Sew across, row {{row}}, from pin {{from}} to pin {{to}}
play.seamDown: Sew down, column {{column}}, from pin {{from}} to pin {{to}}

errors.notALine: That seam isn't on this quilt.
